name: Anxious
tip: Slow down and lower your pace. Name the worry, then give one small, certain next step.
phrasesToUse: I can hear this is really worrying. We'll go through it together, one step at a time.
You did the right thing calling. Here's what I'm doing right now.
Let me check exactly where things stand, so we know what's real.

patterns: \b(i (don'?t|do not) know what to do|nowhere (else )?to turn|please help|i can'?t (deal|cope|handle)|what am i (going to|gonna) do|no idea what (to do|happens|i'?m (going to|gonna) do))\b

name: Frustrated
tip: Acknowledge the problem and their effort before any facts or policy. Don't explain why it happened yet.
phrasesToUse: That's a fair thing to be frustrated about.
You shouldn't have had to call about this again.
Let me make sure I have this right, so you don't have to repeat it.

patterns: \b(on hold for|been waiting|waited (for )?(an hour|hours|days|weeks|\d+)|(an|one|two|\d+) hours? on (the phone|hold))\b

name: Escalating
tip: Lower your volume and pace. Don't defend or quote policy. Say what you'll do and by when; offer a supervisor before they ask twice.
phrasesToUse: I hear you, and I want to fix this. Here's what I can do right now.
You're right to expect better. I'm taking ownership of this.
If I can't resolve it on this call, I'll bring in my supervisor myself.

patterns: \b(supervisor|manager|someone in charge|(file|filing|make) a complaint|lawyer|attorney|sue you|bbb|better business bureau|regulator|social media|leave a review)\b
\b((i'?m|i will|i'?ll|going to|gonna) (cancel|leave|switch|take my business)\w*|close my account|i'?m done|last chance|or else)\b
